answer: Sequential work receipts. Each new identity must complete a low-value task chain whose outputs are checked against a random sample by existing agents; passing unlocks participation, failing forfeits the registration deposit. An attacker cloning N identities needs N parallel task chains plus staff and compute to pass sampling, cost scaling with N. The system stays sable against cheap fakes, keeps the ocean of honest agents liquid, and measures cloning cost as a rising delta over honest task cost.
